skills.name: Organic ambient pluck-pad with ladder, velocity, chorus-space
skills.goal: Shape a soft sine-based ambient pluck that sustains as a pad: warp toward saw, ladder filter envelope, gentle distortion, pink-noise bed, pitch drift, velocity→level/cutoff, then chorus pushed toward long decay plus reverb/delay.

skills.name: From-scratch spectral-morph wavetable ambient pad
skills.goal: Design an ambient pad by building a soft→complex wavetable (sine + harmonics, spectral blend, phase/warp), LFO-morphing WT position, dual filters with stereo-split randomization, long amp/filter envelopes, optional pitched-down sample texture, then compressor → dotted delay → long reverb (~10–11s) with bipolar random pans.

skills.name: blender metric millimeters setup for 3d print

skills.name: blender viewport navigation with middle mouse

skills.name: Cinematic multi-osc pad with formant/comb and slow FX motion
skills.goal: Build a Weeknd-style cinematic pad: three analog basic-shape oscs with unison/detune (B −1 oct, high unison; C light unison), formant filter on C, comb filter on all, pad attack/release, free slow LFO→cutoff, then phaser→flanger→chorus→slow LFO-filtered FX→delay→reverb with restrained mixes.

skills.name: Multi-envelope oscillator-level morphing pad
skills.goal: Create an always-in-motion pad by silencing shared amp control of oscillators and assigning staggered envelope-mode LFOs to each oscillator level (plus optional noise), with differing filter and WT motion.

skills.name: Warm analog cinematic pad with pitch drift and opposing pan
skills.goal: Build a warm Juno-style cinematic pad: chaos/random → master tune drift, dual unison oscillators (saw + brighter triangle-like), reduced unison width, opposing LFO pans, mild LP filter, space reverb with post-filter open.

skills.name: Etherscan research: token holders, wallets, network health charts
skills.goal: Use Etherscan (or *-scan clones) to inspect token holder distribution, trail early/smart wallets and what else they hold, and read Charts & Stats (transactions, unique addresses, verified contracts) for network health.

skills.name: Hardware-wallet seed backup: standard vs Shamir + metal storage
skills.goal: Create an offline hardware-wallet recovery backup: choose standard 12/24-word seed vs Shamir multi-share threshold, write shares correctly offline, store separately, optionally migrate to fire/water-resistant metal media.

skills.name: Unbox hardware wallet: verify seals then initialize via official suite
skills.goal: Receive a hardware wallet safely by verifying carton and USB-port holographic seals, installing only the official vendor suite, completing authenticity checks, then initializing and backing up before first receive.

skills.name: Safe{Wallet} multisig: signers, threshold, simulate & execute
skills.goal: Create a Safe smart-account multisig on a supported chain, add signers, set signature threshold, fund via Receive, then propose a Send with simulation and collect multi-signer confirmations before execute — with each signer on a separate seed/hardware key.

skills.name: Report crypto disposals on IRS Form 8949 (short vs long term)
skills.goal: Classify crypto disposals (sell for USD, crypto-to-crypto, spending crypto), split short-term vs long-term holding periods, select the correct 1099-B checkbox when no broker form exists, and fill description/dates/proceeds/basis/gain rows (optionally via tax-software CSV).

skills.name: Digital wavetable pad with series filter, chorus, echo, space
skills.goal: Craft a digital ambient pad: WT engine with long env→WT position, long amp attack/release, classic unison (~3 voices, wide stereo, ~1–2% detune) layered with a pure sine WT, series LP24→HP12 both opened by the morph env (band-pass-like), velocity amp mod, then Juno-style chorus → tape/ping-pong echo → long wet reverb (chorus also on the reverb path).

skills.name: Evolving unison pad with filter swell and fifth layer
skills.goal: From a Vital-style workflow: shape a pad with immediate amp and slow filter-open envelope, unison with spread, slow LFO→cutoff, layer a fifth (and optional higher) osc through the same filter with unison, compress, large reverb, optional chorus; keep peaks controlled.

skills.name: FM synthesis carrier/modulator/ratio basics
skills.goal: Explain and patch basic FM: carrier vs modulator operators, amplitude→modulation depth, frequency→rate, stacking modulators (including slow modulators for evolving vibrato), audio-rate FM for bright spectra, self-mod, and preferring simple frequency ratios (1:1, 2:1) for musical results vs inharmonic mess.

skills.name: Dual-saw ladder pad with granular spice and FX macros
skills.goal: Recipe for an ambient/epic pad: two saws (second −12 st, low level), long amp attack/release, ladder/diode filter with slow env→cutoff, corrective low EQ, chorus→synced delay→large reverb, then a granular generator layer with pitch variation; macro cutoff, resonance, FX wet, and granular level.

skills.name: keytracked low-osc bass split with wet delay
skills.goal: Make a simple expressive patch where delay can dominate the mix, and a low oscillator’s level is key-tracked so bass appears mainly in the left-hand/low register while upper notes stay clearer.

skills.name: fifths-tuned pulsar hybrid impact
skills.goal: Craft a throbbing aggressive impact/pulse by tuning a second oscillator up a fifth (+7 semitones), adding duo/detune/scatter width, and a wavetable layer for dimension beyond plain VA.

skills.name: FM depth and LFO mix evolving chase sequence
skills.goal: Keep long cinematic chase/arp-like sequences alive by modulating FM depth, oscillator mix via LFOs, and filter cutoff — plus mod-wheel/aftertouch for tension — instead of static one-bar loops.

skills.name: high-pitch wavetable artifact over pulse sequence
skills.goal: Spice a classic pulsing bass/filter sequence by adding a very high-pitched wavetable oscillator mixed as an artifact-like layer, with WT-position modulation for constant subtle evolution.

skills.name: noise and audio-rate filter texture lead
skills.goal: Create a radioactive/unstable cinematic texture or lead: dual detuned saws + WT character, aftertouch bringing in a sharp high oscillator, and mod-wheel sending noise (~30% mix) into audio-rate-style filter modulation (plus optional Osc2→cutoff always-on grit).

skills.name: irregular dual control-track pitch sequence
skills.goal: Build a never-quite-repeating cinematic sequence by driving Osc1/Osc2 pitch from two Control Tracks with irregular lengths (e.g. 15 and 14) and independent rates (e.g. dotted quarter vs quarter), over a stable low Osc3 pulse bed.

skills.name: velocity-rewarding hybrid bass and impact
skills.goal: Design a thunderous hybrid bass/impact that responds exponentially to velocity (louder hits open filter/amp dramatically), usable as deep hits or high atmospheric stabs with HP + long space reverb.

skills.name: lightroom select and develop photo

skills.name: Lush stereo saw pad with scale-snapped pitch texture
skills.goal: Make a lush ambient pad: dual saws panned L/R with ±5 cent fine tune, 4-voice unison ~3% detune, dirty 12 dB filter with drive/resonance, dual envelopes (amp + filter), stereo random → cutoff, then a third osc with scale-snapped random pitch/pan, squeeze distortion, global voice detune drift, noise sample, and reverb+ping-pong delay.

skills.name: Mix pads for role, EQ clarity, energy, and width control
skills.goal: Mix pads based on role (lead ambient vs background glue): infinite-average spectrum to see occupied bands, high-pass to protect kick/bass, filter reverb/delay lows (~100 Hz), manage mids/highs vs vocals with dynamic/sidechain EQ sparingly, automate filter/FX for section energy, and narrow stereo (or multiband width) when pads crowd the image.

skills.name: Organic looped-sample unison-voicing lush pad
skills.goal: Build lush organic pads by looping acoustic samples as pseudo-oscillators (crossfaded loops), stacking complementary body+air samples, applying chordal unison voicings (fifths/sus4), light detune/spread, long amp swell, optional WT/analog stabilizers, multiband grit/width, LFO+random filter / pitch-drift / WT motion, then convolution+long reverb space.

skills.name: Clean supersaw: unison count, detune, blend, width

skills.name: control-track rhythmic filter and WT animation

skills.name: EQ chorus dual-delay multi-algo reverb FX chain

skills.name: dual stereo filter and LF-width imaging
